proposedTarget: 이 Bindery 버전은 사용자별 요청을 지원한다고 명시하지 않습니다. SeerrNG는 API 키를 통해 승인된 책을 추가하므로 Bindery는 서비스 계정을 소유자로 기록합니다.
rationale: This says the version does not explicitly state support, avoiding the current wording’s commercial sense of advertising.
source: This Bindery version does not advertise per-user requests. SeerrNG will add approved books through the API key, so Bindery records the service account as owner.

head: 1fdec93d1b021e4ec7a7c2265230f59d81d2675e

rationale: Tidak menyatakan dukungan describes an unadvertised capability more accurately than the current commercial sense of tidak mengiklankan.
